mostWorthwhile.text: Configuring the intake reader locally and then checking the shipment made the delivery feel complete, and showed why a working route alone was not enough.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying the intake reader before it was locally configured was frustrating; its missing setup was not apparent from the attempted combination.

surprise.text: The supplies could not be processed on arrival until the reader was connected to the clinic's local order list.

arbitrary.text: The first attempt to move the cart through the wicket instead automatically released it against the collection request. The check made sense afterward, but its priority was not obvious beforehand.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the concrete payoff of the shared passage and the careful distinction between reporting and fixing a problem made me curious about the next shift's work.
